start_frame: The sh078-sh080 close returned to exactly — same lens, same height, same axis, same framing: her face whole, lit only by broken reflections, stopping dead as she hears her own answers.
end_frame: The identical frame as she names Mabel, appalled and certain; nothing in the set-up has changed since the hands insert, so the aria closes back up as one continuous thing.
constraint_honoured: 'Returning to the identical frame is what makes the aria read as one continuous thing broken only for her hands.'
movement_note: Exact reproduction is the point, so the shot can have no move and no new framing at all. LN-ep01-025 (5.1 s) sits whole in 6.5 s.
